name: staticlayer
description: StaticLayer v1 — BYOC comment system for static sites (Cloudflare Worker + D1).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @staticlayer/protocol && npm run build --workspace @staticlayer/widget && node scripts/sync-static.mjs && npm run build --workspace @staticlayer/cli && npm run build --workspace @staticlayer/installer && npm run build --workspace @staticlayer/installer-worker
scripts.test:security: npm run build && vitest run tests/security
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build && [ -f apps/demo/.dev.vars ] || cp apps/demo/.dev.vars.example apps/demo/.dev.vars && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply staticlayer-demo-local --local -c apps/demo/wrangler.local.jsonc && npx wrangler dev -c apps/demo/wrangler.local.jsonc --port 8787
scripts.dev:installer: npm run build --workspace @staticlayer/installer && STATICLAYER_DEV_MODE=1 STATICLAYER_SESSION_SECRET=local-installer-session-secret STATICLAYER_CLIENT_ID=local-oauth-client-id STATICLAYER_CLIENT_SECRET=local-oauth-client-secret STATICLAYER_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:8788/oauth/callback npm run start --workspace @staticlayer/installer
scripts.dev:installer:worker: npm run build:installer-worker && npx wrangler dev -c apps/installer-worker/wrangler.jsonc --local --port 8789
